items.text: Laba bangabantwana bakoIsrayeli; oRubeni, noSimeyoni, noLevi, noJuda, no-Isakare, noZebuloni,
uDani, noJosefa, noBenjamini, noNafetali, noGadi, no-Asheri.
Amadodana kaJuda; u-Eri, no-Onani, noShela; abathathu wazalelwa endodakazini kaShuwa umKhanani. U-Eri izibulo likaJuda wayemubi emehlweni kaJehova; wambulala.
UTamari umalokazana wakhe wamzalela uPerezi noSeraki. Wonke amadodana kaJuda ayemahlanu.
Amadodana kaPheresi; uHezironi noHamuli.
Oonyana bakaSeraki ngu oZimri, no-Ethani, noHemani, noKalikoli, noDara, beyisihlanu bebonke.
Amadodana kaKarmi: U-Akhari, umnyundeli ka-Israyeli, owaphambuka endabeni eqalekisiweyo.
Amadodana ka-Ethani ngu u-Azariya.
Lamadodana kaHezironi azalelwa wona: noJerakimeli, noRamu, noKelubhayi.
URamu wazala u-Aminadaba; u-Aminadaba wazala uNaheshoni, inhloko yabantwana bakwaJuda;
uNagison wazala uSalima, noSalima kuBowazi,
UBhowazi wazala u-Obede, no-Obede kuJese,
UJese wazala izibulo lakhe u-Eliyabe, no-Abinadaba owesibili, noShima owesithathu,
noNethaneli owesine, noRadayi owesihlanu,
u-Otsemu owesithupha, uDavida owesikhombisa;
Odadewabo babengoZeruya no-Abigayili. Oonyana bakaSeruya ngu u-Abishayi, noJowabe, no-Asaheli, bebathathu.
U-Abigayili wazala u-Amasa; uyise ka-Amasa wayenguYetere umIshmayeli.
UKalebi, indodana kaHezironi, wazala abantwana bakwa-Azuba, umkakhe, nabakwaJeriot; amadodana akhe yilawa; uJezeri noSobabi no-Ardoni.
Wafa u-Asuba, uKalebi wazithathela u-Efrati, wamzalela uHure.
UHure wazala u-Uri, u-Uri wazala uBhetsaleli.
Emveni koko wayingena uHetseron intombi kaMagire, uyise kaGiliyadi, wayizeka eminyaka imashumi mathandathu ezelwe; wamzalela uSegubi.
USegubi wazala uYayire, owayenemizi engamashumi amabili nantathu ezweni lakwaGileyadi.
Wathatha kubo iGeshuri ne-Aramu nemizi yaseJayire, neKenati nemizi yayo, imizi engamashumi ayisithupha. Bonke labo babe ngamadodana kaMagire uyise kaGileyadi.
Emva kokufa kukaHetseroni eKalebefratha, u-Abiya umkaHezironi wamzalela u-Ashuri uyise kaThekhowa.
Amadodana kaJerakimeli, izibulo likaHezironi: ngoRamu izibulo, noBhuna, no-Oreni, no-Osemu, no-Ahiya.
UJerameli wayenomunye umfazi ogama lakhe lalingu-Athara; wayengunina ka-Onamu.
Amadodana kaRamu izibulo likaJerakimeli kwakunguMahase noJamini no-Ekeri.
Amadodana ka-Onamu kwakunguSamayi noJada. Amadodana kaSamayi ngu uNadab no-Abisur.
Igama lomka-Abhisuri lalingu-Abhihayili; wamzalela o-Agibani noMolidi.
Amadodana kaNadabi ngu Seledi no-Aphayimi, kepha uSeledi wafa engenamntwana.
Amadodana ka-Aphayimi: Ishi. Amadodana kaIshi: Sheshan. Amadodana kaSheshani; Ahlai.
Amadodana kaJada, umfowabo kaSamayi; uJetheri noJonathani, noJeteri bafa bengenamntwana.
Amadodana kaJonathani: UPeleth noZaza. Lawa kwakungamadodana kaJerameli.
USeshani wayengenamadodana, enamadodakazi odwa. Futhi uSheshani wayenenceku, umGibhithe, ogama lakhe lalinguJariha.
USeshani wanika uJariha inceku yakhe indodakazi yakhe ibe ngumkakhe; wamzalela u-Athayi.
U-Athayi wazala uNathani, noNathani waseSabadi,
UZabadi wazala u-Efali, no-Efelali ku-Obede;
U-Obede wazala uJehu, noJehu ku-Azariya,
U-Azariya wazala uHelesi, uHelesi wazala u-Eleyasa;
U-Eleyasa wazala uShisamayi, uShisamayi wazala uShalumi;
UShalum wazala uYekamiya noJekamiya ka-Elishama.
Amadodana kaKalebi, umfowabo kaJerakimeli: nguMesha izibulo lakhe, onguyise kaSifi; lamadodana kaMaresa, uyise kaHebroni.
Amadodana kaHebroni: uKora, noThaphuwa, noRekemi, noShema.
UShema wazala uRahamu, uyise kaYokowamu, noRekemu kaSamai.
Indodana kaSamayi yayinguMahoni, uMahoni wazala iBhete-suri.
U-Efa, isancinza sikaKalebhi, wazala uHarana, noMose, noGase; uHarana wazala uGase.
Amadodana kaJagidayi ngu uRegemu, noJothamu, noGeshan, noPheleti, no-Efa, noShaaf.
UMahaga, isancinza sikaKalebi, wazala oSebebhere noTirihana.
Wazala noShahafi, uyise wabaseMademana, noSewa, uyise wabaseMagebhena, noyise wabaseGibheha; indodakazi kaKalebi ibingu-Asa.
Lawa angamadodana kaKalebi, indodana kaHure, izibulo lika-Efrati; uShobali uyise kaKiriyati Jeharimi,
uSalima, uyise wabaseBhetelehem, uHaref, uyise wabaseBhete-gadere.
UShobhali uyise kaKiriyati Jeharimi wayenamadodana; IHaro nengxenye yamaManachete.
Imindeni kaKiriyati Jeharimi; amaItiri, namaPugi, namaSumati, namaMisrai; kubo kwaphuma abaseZareya nama-Estawuli.
Amadodana kaSalima; IBhetelehem, namaNethofa, neAtharoti, nendlu kaYowabhi, nenxenye yamaManake, namaZori.
Izizukulwana zababhali ababehlala eJabeshi; amaTire, namaSimeya, namaSuga. Lawa ngamaKheni avela kuHemati uyise wendlu kaRekabi.
